title: Zhu Zaiyu
description: Chinese prince, mathematician, physicist and music theorist (1536–1611)
extract: Zhu Zaiyu was a Chinese scholar, mathematician and music theorist. He was a prince of the Chinese Ming dynasty. In 1584, Zhu innovatively described the equal temperament via accurate mathematical calculation.
